proverbs.igbo: Nwaanyi muta aju ugboro abuo, o mara ihe na-egbu ya n'isi.
proverbs.literal: If a woman prepares a head-pad twice, she knows what hurts her head.
proverbs.meaning: Experience teaches wisdom and caution in life.

proverbs.igbo: E mee ngwa ngwa, e meghara ọdachi.
proverbs.literal: When done quickly, disaster is averted.
proverbs.meaning: Prompt action solves problems before they escalate.

proverbs.igbo: Onye na-amaghị ebe mmiri si maba ya agaghị ama ebe ọ kwụsịrị ịma ya.
proverbs.literal: A person who does not know where the rain began to beat him will not know where it stopped beating him.
proverbs.meaning: Know your roots and your journey to understand your destiny.
